_formato: Properties of the background gas of the case, read by the simulator (prototipo/modelo.py).
fundo: species of kinet.inp that form the background gas and their fractions.
cv_por_kb: specific heat at constant volume per heavy particle, in units of k_B (1.5 for a monatomic gas, 2.5 for a diatomic one without vibration).

condutividade: thermal conductivity in W/(m K); tipo linear_com_raiz, (a T + b) escala, times (T/t_raiz)^(1/2) above t_raiz, or tipo tabela, with T (K) and kappa, interpolated linearly and clamped at the ends.
ion_inicial: positive ion seeded with the electrons in the neutral initial plasma.

calor (optional): enthalpies of formation (eV) of the species; each heavy-particle reaction with more than one reactant releases -sum(nu h) as gas heat (those of BOLSIG+ and the single-reactant, radiative ones are left out); with --energy, the mean energy of the consumed electrons too. Without the block, the gas is heated only by the elastic loss and by ion Joule heating.

calor.processos_rapidos (optional): processes of bolsigdb.dat whose energy becomes gas heat within picoseconds (for example N2 -> N2(rot)); ferramentas/caso.py heat and tables write their power to tabela_calor_tg.dat (net of de-excitation, limited by the inelastic loss), which the gas receives.
The fonte fields are only a record of the source.
fonte: conductivity of the Fortran code (DF in termico.f90); cv of a monatomic gas
